outcome: Gut microbiota composition and development during the first 1000 days of life
finding: This review highlights the impact of complementary feeding on gut microbiota development, particularly the increase in diversity associated with the transition to family foods.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery is mentioned as a factor affecting gut microbiota establishment in early life.
followup_time: Up to 2 years (first 1000 days of life)
